name: relai-panel
description: RelAI panel for Claude Code (early access mods): a card above the prompt with the active plan and stage and the session's hypothetical API cost (the prompt-cache timer is relai-cache-keeper's); /relai-panel opens a pane with forms for the 14 RelAI commands, the project's cheat sheet, the session phrases, the session's measured costs (main loop, subagents, compactions; per agent, model and stage, priced at a dated list) and a map of the plans, their stages and branches and the /relai-crew runs, with the cost of each stage. Measurements go to .claude/relai/pomiary/, a file per session, each tagged with the stage in progress and the crew task. Silent outside RelAI projects.
